card.title: Rightful Place
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the rightful holder of your role and treat any demand for proof as an insult.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why is someone sitting in my chair at the founders' dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's a sponsor. Have you brought your founder's invitation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You need an envelope to establish that I founded this place?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know you did. I'll bring another chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For him, thank you. Put mine back at the head.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims the founder's chair, A3 treats invitation proof as insulting, and A5 restores its rightful placement after B offers accommodation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's invitation request causes A3's offended challenge; B4's extra chair becomes A5's instruction to move the sponsor instead.

relationship.evidence: B2 manages dinner seating and B4 acknowledges A's founding role while proposing a practical solution.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's extra chair to preserve both the claimed chair and its head position.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a founders' dinner and occupied chair; B2 identifies the sponsor seated there.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's brief correction of who gets the new chair earns its entitlement from B4's concession.
